parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is the lens of the camera, made primarily of optical glass with a cylindrical shape extending from the camera body.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the camera sensor or film to capture images with clarity and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for focusing or zooming, depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is a control button on the top of the camera, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to trigger the shutter or control camera functions such as power or mode selection.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another button on the camera, also made of plastic, likely used for secondary functions.
parts.Functional_description: It may control additional features such as zoom, flash, or menu navigation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, similar to the main shutter button.

parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is another section of the lens assembly, made of optical glass and metal housing.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to focusing and zooming, forming part of the optical system.
parts.Movement_description: It can extend or retract during focusing or zooming operations.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the camera, made of aluminum alloy for strength and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal components such as the sensor, battery, and circuit boards, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main support for all other parts.
